parameters.content:
## 1 · Trigger and settings
Daily 09:00 or manual run. Every setting lives in **Demo Settings**.

## 2 · Extract, politely
Read the ledger, check **robots.txt**, fetch the index, pick an article never used before.

## 3 · Fetch the article
Wait (crawl delay), read title, summary and image.

## 4 · Generate with guardrails
LLM draft, then rule checks and evidence quotes, then a second LLM audit.

## 5 · Publish
simulate / **Mastodon** (live) / Facebook (implemented, not run live).

## 6 · Log, review, alert
Ledger row per run, Telegram draft in approval mode, alert on failure.

## Failures
Every node's error output goes to one failure record, then the ledger, then a Telegram alert, then the run is marked failed.
